description: This source file implements the GrainCancellationTokenRuntime class which manages cancellation tokens for grains, including methods for cancelling tokens with retries, and a serializer class for GrainCancellationToken objects.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenRuntime
classes.description: Manages cancellation tokens for grains, providing methods to cancel tokens and handle retries.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenCodec
classes.description: Serializer for GrainCancellationToken objects, converting to and from surrogate representations.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenSurrogate
classes.description: Data transfer object used as a surrogate for serializing GrainCancellationToken instances.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the specified grain cancellation token and propagates the cancellation to all referenced grain references, with error retries.

methods.name: CancelTokenWithRetries
methods.description: Performs remote token cancellation with retries, handling exceptions and attempting multiple retries.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate object to a GrainCancellationToken instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a GrainCancellationToken instance into its surrogate representation.
